Research

We study the brain circuits responsible for cognitive decline in Lewy body disease, using multimodal neuroimaging, cognitive and behavioural testing, fluid biomarkers and non-invasive stimulation techniques.

Current projects

Multimodal neuroimaging

Quantitative MRI, diffusion MRI, functional imaging and molecular PET are integrated at subject and regional levels.
